description: This header file declares interface functions and constants related to EGO (Exhaust Gas Oxygen) sensors in the engine control firmware. It includes function prototypes for getting AFR (Air-Fuel Ratio), checking sensor presence, setting EGO sensor type, and initializing EGO sensor averaging.

methods.name: getAfr
methods.description: Retrieves the current AFR value from the EGO sensor.

methods.name: hasAfrSensor
methods.description: Checks if an AFR sensor is present.

methods.name: setEgoSensor
methods.description: Sets the type of EGO sensor used.
